response.original_title: Mozart: The Old City String Quartet - 3D
response.overview: The Old City String Quartet performs Mozart's Clarinet Quintet K. 581, String Quartet K. 169 and Horn Quintet K. 407, joined by clarinetist Ruokai Chen and horn player Corey Klein. Mark Waldrep directs and produces the programme in both 2D and 3D.
response.title: Mozart: The Old City String Quartet - 3D
